The professor was extremely disengaged. Feedback was late, generic, or missing entirely, and the course shell and due dates were disorganized. As long as you do work in the allotted in class work time you will probably not have much of any homework for this class. Her projects are also all super interesting and nothing like I have done before. Take her if you can!

She is very lenient on grades. If you follow the criteria on the rubric you will get full points, so the class is not difficult to get full points. Not much work should be done outside of class unless if you don't work in class which she gives a lot of time to do (like 30-40 minutes) per class. She's also very chill and throws some jokes randomly.

This professor is an incredible professor, she helps so many students and she is very understanding. she helped me learn my writers voice as well as learning how to write better in general. This class has a perfect learning environment. If I could take this class again I definitely would, this class is a perfect class to take when you are starting

She also tries her best so that you never have homework outside of the classroom. She helps answer questions clearly and does a very good job teaching new topics in fun ways. I would advise taking her class!

Personally this class under this professor was a great experience. The class becomes better if you're willing to interact as a class - be overall social. Dr. Szeto, although a boring lecturer, wants students to do well in his course. He allows cheat sheets on each exam (extra on the final), drops your lowest exam score, and provides practice exams for each unit that are nearly identical to the real exams (which were never more than 30 questions).

He does ramble A LOT in his lectures and takes a while to get to the point, attendance is not graded for lecture but I would definitely recommend attending and sitting in front so you can truly pay attention.
